thread:
Amelia: @channel paging oncall — IncBot just opened a P1 for the streaming-inference router. High 5xx rate from the kv-cache shard in us-west-2. Seeing increased latency and customer errors. Can oncall grab this?

IncBot: [ALERT] streaming-inference-router:kv-cache-usw2 high-error-rate - triggered 1908765432 - runbooks/streaming/kv-cache-usw2.md

Santiago: oncall team is on it? I can start drafting customer messages and queue the CS macros.

Amelia: I'm on the bridge. Quick status: errors started ~5m ago, spike to ~18% 5xx for traffic routed to kv-cache-usw2. Working hypothesis: degraded kv-cache node causing timeouts and cascading retries. Priya joining.

Priya: Confirmed elevated RPC timeouts on node shard-07. I'm rolling a config to fail-fast on that shard to stop retry storms, then we'll restart the process. Will post commands.

Nick: I'll prepare an initial customer ack macro for Zendesk/Intercom — something minimal we can send in <10m. Also need an internal statuspage draft.

Santiago: Drafting here so we can iterate quickly. Suggest three artifacts: 1) public statuspage update 2) customer acknowledgement template (Zendesk/Intercom) 3) internal incident comm for CSMs and SREs with triage/handoff checklist.

Amelia: Yes. Keep the public update short: impact, mitigation in progress, ETA for next update. Avoid technical root cause in public message until confirmed.

Santiago: DRAFT - Public statuspage entry (short):

"We are currently investigating elevated errors for streaming inference in the US-West region. Some requests may return errors or experience higher latency. Our engineering team is actively investigating and mitigating the issue. We will provide an update within 30 minutes."

Santiago: Draft - Customer acknowledgement (Zendesk / Intercom quick-reply macro):

Subject: We’re investigating errors affecting streaming inference (US‑West)

Body:
Hi {{customer.name}},

Thanks for the report — we’re currently investigating an issue affecting streaming inference in the US‑West region which may cause errors or delays. Our engineers are actively working on a mitigation. We’ll follow up within 30 minutes with an update.

If you can, please share a sample request ID or timestamp for the failed requests (optional) — that can help us trace traffic.

Apologies for the disruption,
{{agent.signature}}

Santiago: Macro tags: `incident=streaming-usw2`, `severity=investigating`, `notify-cs=true`

Nick: Nice. Adding an internal message for CSM/SRE handoff with suggested lines for email/Slack to affected customers: keep it factual, offer a temporary workaround if available.

Nick: DRAFT - CS email snippet to send to affected customers (if needed):

Subject: Update: issue affecting streaming inference (US‑West)

Hi {{customer.name}},

We wanted to let you know we are investigating an operational incident that may affect streaming inference in the US‑West region. Some requests may see higher latency or occasional errors. Our engineers have applied a mitigation to route around a degraded cache node and are validating recovery.

Temporary workaround: If your workload allows, consider routing inference requests to the US‑East region (region=us-east-1) until we confirm full recovery. If you need help switching regions we can assist.

We’ll send another update in ~30 minutes.

Thanks for your patience,
{{cs.name}}

Amelia: Good. Also add a short internal checklist for oncall --> next oncall handoff and severity tracking so the next shift has context. Keep it compact.

Priya: Here's the triage and mitigation checklist I'm pasting (use as runbook appendix):

Triage & Mitigation Checklist:
- Confirm alert scope: `curl -s https://monitoring/api/alerts/1908765432`
- Identify impacted shards: check `kv-cache` metrics for lag/timeout > 200ms
- Temporary mitigation: set `KV_CACHE_FAIL_FAST=true` on shard node(s) or update routing weight for `kv-cache-usw2` to 0.
- Restart affected process: `kubectl -n inference rollout restart deployment/kv-cache-shard-07`
- Validate: tail logs `kubectl -n inference logs -f deployment/kv-cache-shard-07 | grep ERROR`
- If errors persist >10m, failover traffic to `kv-cache-usw2-standby` or increase read-through to upstream storage.
- Post-mitigation: snapshot metrics and add to incident ticket (cpu/mem/latency traces).

Priya: Applying fail-fast now: `kubectl -n inference set env deployment/kv-cache-shard-07 KV_CACHE_FAIL_FAST=true`

Amelia: Good call. Priya, ping when restart is complete. Santiago/Nick, keep customer templates ready.

Priya: Restart complete, a few restarts, now traffic dropping to unaffected nodes. Error rate down to ~3% and latency improving.

IncBot: [UPDATE] streaming-inference-router:kv-cache-usw2 mitigation applied - error rate decreased - 1908765500

Santiago: Updating public statuspage to add mitigation note. DRAFT (update 2):

"Update: We have applied a mitigation to route traffic away from a degraded cache shard in US‑West. Error rates have decreased and we continue to monitor. Some customers may still experience intermittent errors. Next update in 60 minutes or when we confirm full recovery."

Nick: Sending customer ack to queued tickets with slight customization. Samples: one short for low-impact customers, one with workaround for high volume customers.

Santiago: Internal handoff note for next oncall (copy into incident ticket):
- Incident ID: 1908765432
- Summary: Kv-cache shard degraded in us-west causing elevated 5xx and latency for streaming inference. Mitigation: fail-fast enabled, deployment restart, routing weight reduced.
- Current status: recovering, error rate ~3% -> monitoring for 30m stability window.
- Next steps: watch for error rate regressions (>5%) and validate end-to-end for top 10 affected customers.
- Oncall to escalate to Eng Infra if error rate >10% or if failover fails.

Amelia: Perfect. One more internal snippet for the #ops-notify channel and exec summary (short):

Ops notify (short):
Inc 1908765432 — Streaming inference errors in US‑West. Mitigation applied; service recovering. Monitoring.

Exec summary (1‑line):
Streaming inference (US‑West) experienced degraded cache node causing increased errors — mitigated, under observation.

Priya: I'll attach logs and the `kubectl` outputs to the incident ticket, and add a link to the runbook.

Santiago: Final note: let's add a quick Intercom async reply macro for self-serve customers who open new chats:

Intercom macro (quick reply):
Hi there — thanks for flagging this. We're aware of an issue impacting streaming inference in US‑West and are actively mitigating. You can subscribe to our status page for live updates: https://status.redwood.ai. We apologize for the inconvenience.

Amelia: Thanks team. Closing here — next update in 30m or earlier if status changes. I'll hand off to the afternoon oncall with the internal checklist. :thumbsup:

IncBot: [CLOSE] Incident 1908765432 - status changed to monitoring - 1908765732

Santiago: Tagging all artifacts into the incident ticket and creating two macros in Zendesk: `Streaming-USW2-Ack` and `Streaming-USW2-Update`.

Nick: I'll follow up with CS to prioritize customers that reported errors in the last hour.

Priya: Adding post-incident action items to ticket: investigate root cause for shard-07 failure mode, add stronger health checks to avoid future retry storms.

Amelia: Great work, everyone.
